proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q r hab hr
  have hN : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    by_cases ha₀ : a = 0
    · have hb₀ : b ≠ 0 := fun hb₀ => hab ⟨ha₀, hb₀⟩
      positivity
    · positivity
  have hd : |a * p + b * q + c| / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) < r ↔ (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hN), ← sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity), sq_abs, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hN.le]
  rw [hd]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, w = a * p + b * q + c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hw]
  have hpt : ∀ K : ℝ, K ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 → (a * (p - (a * w + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) + b * (q - (b * w - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) + c = 0 ∧ (p - (a * w + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - p) ^ 2 + (q - (b * w - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - q) ^ 2 = r ^ 2) := by
    intro K hK
    constructor
    · rw [hw]; field_simp; ring
    · have : (p - (a * w + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - p) ^ 2 + (q - (b * w - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - q) ^ 2 = (w ^ 2 + K ^ 2) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [this, hK]
      field_simp; ring
  have hle : ∀ x y : ℝ, a * x + b * y + c = 0 → (x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 → (b * (x - p) - a * (y - q)) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 := by
    intro x y hl hc
    have hw' : w = -(a * (x - p) + b * (y - q)) := by rw [hw]; linear_combination hl
    rw [hw', ← hc]; ring
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x₁, y₁, x₂, y₂, hne, hl₁, hc₁, hl₂, hc₂⟩
    have h₁ := hle x₁ y₁ hl₁ hc₁
    have h₂ := hle x₂ y₂ hl₂ hc₂
    by_contra hge
    push Not at hge
    have hle0 : r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by linarith
    have he₁ : b * (x₁ - p) - a * (y₁ - q) = 0 :=
      pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (le_antisymm (h₁.trans_le hle0) (sq_nonneg _))
    have he₂ : b * (x₂ - p) - a * (y₂ - q) = 0 :=
      pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (le_antisymm (h₂.trans_le hle0) (sq_nonneg _))
    have ha₁ : a * (x₁ - x₂) + b * (y₁ - y₂) = 0 := by linarith
    have hb₁ : b * (x₁ - x₂) - a * (y₁ - y₂) = 0 := by linarith
    apply hne
    have g₁ : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * (x₁ - x₂) = 0 := by linear_combination a * ha₁ + b * hb₁
    have g₂ : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * (y₁ - y₂) = 0 := by linear_combination b * ha₁ - a * hb₁
    constructor
    · have := (mul_eq_zero.mp g₁).resolve_left hN.ne'
      linarith
    · have := (mul_eq_zero.mp g₂).resolve_left hN.ne'
      linarith
  · intro h
    have hE : 0 < r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - w ^ 2 := ⟨_, Real.sq_sqrt hE.le⟩
    have hKne : K ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl; rw [← hK] at hE; simp at hE
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hpt K hK
    obtain ⟨h₃, h₄⟩ := hpt (-K) (by rw [neg_sq]; exact hK)
    refine ⟨_, _, _, _, ?_, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
    rintro ⟨e₁, e₂⟩
    have g₁ : b * K = 0 := by
      have e : (a * w + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) = (a * w + b * (-K)) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by linarith
      rw [div_left_inj' hN.ne'] at e
      linarith
    have g₂ : a * K = 0 := by
      have e : (b * w - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) = (b * w - a * (-K)) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by linarith
      rw [div_left_inj' hN.ne'] at e
      linarith
    exact hab ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp g₂).resolve_right hKne, (mul_eq_zero.mp g₁).resolve_right hKne⟩
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q r : ℝ), ¬(a = 0 ∧ b = 0) → 0 < r → ((∃ x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : ℝ, ¬(x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = y₂) ∧ a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c = 0 ∧ (x₁ - p) ^ 2 + (y₁ - q) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 ∧ a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c = 0 ∧ (x₂ - p) ^ 2 + (y₂ - q) ^ 2 = r ^ 2) ↔ |a * p + b * q + c| / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) < r)
